title: Impact of Sending 26 MRT Trains Back to Manufacturer on Service Reliability
what_it_is: Impact of Sending 26 MRT Trains Back to Manufacturer on Service Reliability

sections.label: MRT train numbers and buffer
sections.summary: There are 140 MRT trains, with 124 deployed at peak, and about 10% kept as buffer for repairs, upgrading and standby.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: asked 	the Minister for Transport (a) what is the total number of MRT trains deployed for operations currently; (b) among these, what percentage of trains are not embarking passengers as they need to be sent back to the manufacturer CSR Sifang for depot-level train repairs due for completion in 2019; and (c) in what way has this episode affected the Ministry's plans to improve the reliability of the MRT system.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: So, we have 140 trains altogether, but actual deployment, at the maximum, that means, during peak hours, 124.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: It is standard practice in all subway systems to have a buffer, about a 10% of trains for repairs, upgrading and standby.

sections.label: Bolster replacement and reliability
sections.summary: One train at a time is sent to China for bolster replacement, within the 10% buffer, and the incident has not affected reliability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: At any one time, there is only one train sent back to China for the manufacturer to replace the bolsters and, therefore, we are well within the 10% buffer.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The Kawasaki-Sifang train incident has not affected the reliability of the system.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: None of the delays on the trains was due to the bolsters' hairline cracks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: As I said, the problem was with certain batches of aluminium which are manufactured and used for the bolsters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: So, when the manufacturer offered to say from now on, all bolsters will be manufactured in Japan, that settles the issue.

sections.label: Kawasaki ownership of bolster problem
sections.summary: Kawasaki took full ownership, volunteered bolster and car-body replacement, extended warranty, giving free train use and prolonged warranty.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: If the Member has listened carefully to what I have said over the last half an hour, he would note that Kawasaki, at great cost to themselves, has taken full ownership of the problem − not in denial, "not my problem", "somebody else's problem".

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: They went all out to 	Page: 27 protect their reputation, make certain decisions, not at our request, but on their own, volunteered to have the bolsters replaced, to completely replace the car-bodies, extended warranty, restarted the warranty commencement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: What it means is that we have free use of the trains for several years and a prolonged warranty period.
